vibe_rationale: Real urban sports and street-culture scene with a street market, but a free, mass-attendance, contest-led event that leans mass-market.
fit_notes: Large free bayside crowd suits sampling or a recovery space at scale, but skateboarding, BMX and family audiences skew young and the adult share is unverified. About fourteen partners are listed, though no sponsorship packages are published. Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
